title: Tax Reform No. 4: start-up investor CGT discount, electric car FBT and other business changes
shortTitle: Start-up CGT break and business changes
headline: Proposed: investors in eligible start-ups keep an optional 50% CGT discount, the electric car FBT exemption narrows and businesses can pay PAYG monthly. Not law yet.
summary: An omnibus bill implementing Budget 2026-27 measures for start-ups and business: an optional 50% CGT discount for shares in eligible innovative start-ups (the Innovative Business CGT Concession), expanded venture capital incentives, an option to pay PAYG instalments monthly, a narrower FBT exemption for electric cars and a reworked R&D Tax Incentive. It passed the House without amendment on 29 October 2026 and is before the Senate.
effectiveLabel: Electric car changes from 1 April 2027; start-up CGT discount, venture capital and monthly PAYG from 1 July 2027; R&D changes from 1 July 2028

history.note: Passed without amendment; introduced in the Senate on 16 November 2026

bigStat.caption: optional CGT discount kept for shares in eligible start-ups

before: From 1 July 2027 the 50% CGT discount ends for most assets, including start-up shares, replaced by indexation and a 30% minimum tax.
Eligible electric cars below the luxury car tax threshold are fully exempt from FBT.
PAYG instalments are generally paid quarterly.
after: Investors in eligible innovative start-ups can choose a 50% CGT discount on shares held for at least 3 years and issued directly by the company.

An eligible company must be under 15 years old, unlisted, with turnover under $50 million and at least half its staff and assets in Australia. It must pass innovation tests and register with the Department of Industry, Science and Resources.

Electric cars from 1 April 2027: the full FBT exemption only applies to cars costing $75,000 or less under commitments made before 1 April 2029. Dearer cars below the luxury car tax threshold get a 25% FBT discount. From 1 April 2029 new commitments get the 25% discount only.
Businesses can choose to pay PAYG instalments monthly from 1 July 2027, and the ATO can require it of taxpayers with a history of non-compliance.
Venture capital incentives expand from 1 July 2027. The R&D Tax Incentive is reworked from 1 July 2028.
exemptions: Existing electric car leases are not affected.
Shares not issued directly by the company, such as those bought from other investors, don't qualify for the start-up discount.

actions.text: Start-up investors: keep the issue date and documents for shares issued directly to you. The 3-year holding rule and company tests decide eligibility.
Weighing an electric car over $75,000 through salary packaging? If the bill passes, only leases already in place before 1 April 2027 keep the full FBT exemption.
Watch the Senate vote: the bill needs the Greens or crossbench and is being debated alongside the trusts bill.
